record: Reach ledger for one documentary network. A count is not a finding. A reading is not a verdict.
method: The network counter at the top of the finding aid opens the ledger. This page does not add a hit. Archive, finding-aid, church and publishing-house openings are separate keys. A missing key is not a historical zero. Downloads are not added to web hits. The live numbers come from countapi.mileshilliard.com. Each object in readings is a sealed copy. The repository workflow adds one reading on each Sydney day at about 03:15. Git history keeps the file if the live counter is later lost.

readings.note: First seal, made when the web-hit button was placed at the top of the front page. Web hits were opened at the figure already recorded as page visits, so earlier reach is not discarded.

readings.method: GET only. Null means the key did not exist. Null is not zero.
readings.note: First network reading. Church and publishing-house counters had not been started. Their absence is not a record that nobody had opened those pages before this date.

archive.counts: Front page only. One opening adds one page visit and one web hit together.
